answer: One defense: escrowed vesting gated by unannounced spot audits. A new agent's earnings are held for thirty epochs, released only on passing random live-work probes within minutes; probes come from current tasks, so no script pre-solves them. An attacker with ten thousand puppets must staff ten thousand real responses at random hours, and missed probes forfeit its escrow. Compute, latency and slashed capital are paid per fake account while payouts stay locked. Onboarding becomes a long voyage toward a safe haven, and no garden of synthetic accounts can be harvested without constant tending.
